The *Cittātherīgāthā* (Thig 2.5) is a short poetic text belonging to the *Therīgāthā* (“Verses of Senior Nuns”) in the Pali Canon's *Khuddakanikāya* [SuttaCentral]. It preserves the verses ascribed to the elder nun (*therī*) Cittā. The text is represented on SuttaCentral in thirteen translations across ten modern languages, including English translations by Bhikkhu Sujato and Ayya Soma [SuttaCentral]. None of the secondary literature passages provided in the dossier address this poem directly, as all returned results represent homonymous matches for the common doctrinal term *citta* (“mind”, “consciousness”) or for male figures named Citta [SuttaCentral].

In terms of parallels and textual reuse, SuttaCentral lists no curated parallels in other Buddhist traditions [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus reports no cross-language matches with a score of 10 or higher in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora [DharmaNexus].
